library_empty_desc:
Copy each game as a folder (with eboot.bin and sce_sys/) into
%1$s
or add another folder where you already keep them.
option_graphics_backend_desc: Vulkan renders and presents directly (fastest). OpenGL ES shows the final frame through EGL, a compatibility path for devices with a broken Vulkan present path; falls back to Vulkan when unsupported. Applies from the next game start.
option_vulkan_version_desc: Mali only, with the Vulkan backend: run on a Vulkan 1.3 instance (the default) or a Vulkan 1.1 one. 1.1 helps Mali drivers whose 1.3 path misbehaves or that expose the required features only through extensions. Applies from the next game start.
option_resolution_desc: Per axis: a 4K game at 50 % renders at 1080p (a quarter of the work). Lower resolution relieves the GPU; some games do not support it
ue_resolution_desc: Unreal Engine games render near 4K and are slow on mobile GPUs; used unless the game has its own setting
option_async_shaders_desc: Avoids stutter; an object may take a moment to appear
option_stream_mb_desc: Ring for CPU-updated data. Some games fill 64 MB every frame and wait on the GPU; a larger ring avoids that, but may cause visual glitches in a few titles
option_read_ahead_desc: KB downloaded in one wait when a game reads GPU-written buffers page by page (one launch title's render thread). Larger can speed up sequential reads; too large wastes bandwidth on random access
option_yield_us_desc: Unreal titles poll completion with millions of spin-yields; after a burst a short sleep releases the core and the power budget. Off restores pure sched_yield (may help or hurt per title)
option_verbose_desc: Detailed hot-path logging to logcat, for bug reports; slows the game while enabled
option_fence_fallback_desc: Submit to the GPU after every release event. Slower (a blocking submit per fence), but use if a game waits forever on a fence (stuck graphics after loading screens)
gpu_driver_desc: Imported Turnip (Adreno) or PanVK (Mali); System uses the vendor driver
driver_download_desc: Community Turnip (Adreno) or PanVK (Mali) builds; the one you install becomes the global driver
driver_list_failed: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again later.
driver_no_packages: This source has no driver packages.
driver_none_for_gpu: No downloadable drivers for this GPU.
gpu_driver_delete_desc: Games will go back to the system driver
driver_error_no_library: The zip has no driver (.so) or meta.json does not name it
perf_overlay_desc: FPS, CPU, GPU, RAM and temperatures on screen
option_perf_cores_desc: Keep the emulation and graphics threads on the fastest CPU cores (big.LITTLE).
option_present_mode_desc: Low latency keeps triple buffering (default); VSync paces to the display for the smoothest image; Uncapped presents every finished frame for the highest frame rate (may tear). Applies from the next game start.
option_mali_profile_desc: Bandwidth-tuned defaults for Mali GPUs (same graphics): hardware render-target clears that keep AFBC compression alive, a 128 MB streaming buffer and one more pipeline worker. Auto applies it only on Mali GPUs; applies from the next game start.
option_adreno_profile_desc: Snapdragon-tuned defaults (same graphics): a 128 MB streaming buffer, one more shader-compile worker and an extra swapchain image for high-refresh presenting. Auto applies it only on Adreno GPUs; applies from the next game start.
option_refresh_rate_desc: Display mode and emulated vblank for games paced by vblank (same graphics): Auto follows the display’s highest rate, so 90/120 Hz screens stop capping games at 60 FPS; 60 keeps the previous behaviour. Applies from the next game start.
option_frame_generation_desc: Fills idle display ticks with a generated in-between frame, so the presented image runs at the display rate. Real frames are untouched and still appear the moment they finish, so input response stays the same. On by default where the GPU has headroom (off on Mali and older Adreno chips); turn it on or off at will. Applies from the next game start.
option_cfp_max_desc: Full-quality performance mode: nothing is downscaled - textures and render targets keep their exact native resolution and the picture is presented untouched. The speed comes from the CPU side of the emulation: draws that rebind the same shaders and textures skip the whole texture rediscovery pass, and large scene buffers are copied once per render pass instead of once per draw - the actual hot path of heavy titles. The image stays identical to the original while the frame rate gains a large margin. Off by default; applies from the next game start.
reset_game_settings_desc: Clear this game's overrides (options and GPU driver).
adaptive_resolution_desc: Lower the render scale while the game cannot hold its frame rate and raise it back when there is headroom. Applies without restarting.
touch_controls_desc: In automatic mode they hide when a physical controller is connected
touchpad_overlay_desc: Automatic: with the touch controls · Always: also with a physical controller
button_layout_desc: Nintendo swaps A↔B and X↔Y in games (controllers like the Odin's)
custom_controls_desc: Move and resize the on-screen buttons to fit your hands
custom_controls_hint: Drag a cluster to move it, tap to select
folder_add_desc: Games are searched in every folder
clear_shader_cache_desc: They are compiled again while playing
save_log_desc: In the logs folder of your main folder
license_desc: Free software under GPL v2 (GPL-2.0-only), based on KytyPS5 and the original Kyty by InoriRus (MIT). Includes FEX (MIT), SDL (zlib), FFmpeg (LGPL-2.1), libadrenotools (BSD-2) and other open-source components. Contains no Sony software or keys.
layers_desc: Draw passes of the last frame, in order. Turn one off and see what disappears.
error_elf_start: Could not start the executable. Save the log for details.
crash_title: The game closed because of an error
update_checks_desc: Looks for a newer release each time the app starts
update_check_now_desc: Look for a newer release immediately
updates_up_to_date: Console Five Pro is up to date
exit_confirm: Leave the game? The emulator process ends; unsaved in-game progress is kept by the game itself.
option_guest_read_cache_desc: Caches host reads of guest pages. Turn it off only while investigating a memory bug; it costs performance
update_failed: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
update_permission: Allow Console Five Pro to install apps in the screen that just opened, then press Install.
auto_save_desc: Keeps safety copies of the current game saves while playing
saves_export_desc: Writes every game save into one zip file you pick
saves_import_desc: Restores game saves from an Export zip, replacing those games
saves_export_empty: No saved data to export yet
saves_import_empty: The zip contains no game saves
saves_game_export_desc: Writes only this game's saves into a zip you pick
saves_game_import_desc: Restores this game's saves from its zip, replacing them
saves_game_import_empty: The zip contains no saves for this game
import_not_game: That file is not a game executable. Pick the game folder's eboot.bin — .pkg packages must be extracted on a PC first.
import_pkg_not_supported: PKG packages are not supported yet. Import the game's extracted folder (the one with eboot.bin inside) or the eboot.bin itself.
import_no_space: Not enough free space in the library folder to import this game. Free up storage (leftover partial imports are cleaned automatically) and try again.
import_cleaned: Removed %1$d GB of leftover partial imports.
screen_aspect_desc: Shape of the game image; other formats add black bars
support_description: Console Five Pro is free software made in spare time. Join the community on Discord to report games, get help and follow progress.
trophies_desc: Trophy list and what you have earned
trophies_none: This game has no trophy list (sce_sys/trophy2).
trophies_share_text: %1$s: %2$d of %3$d trophies on Console Five Pro
language_desc: Interface language; English is the default
whats_new_items: New: CFP MAX (Settings -> Performance) - a full-quality performance mode. Nothing is downscaled and the picture stays identical to the original; the speed comes from the CPU side of the emulation: draws that reuse the same shaders and textures skip the whole texture rediscovery pass, and large scene buffers are copied once per render pass instead of once per draw. Off by default; applies from the next game start.
Fixed: the windowed-mode flicker - resize storms from the system UI no longer thrash the present path, and the sub-native startup crash is gone too.
Fixed: switching the interface language now reopens Settings instead of bouncing back to the main menu, and the choice applies correctly on Android 15.
New: the redesigned controls editor - the pad lives in its own isolated box, so a button can never be dragged under the panels, and the editor fits small screens.
New: interface languages ship as JSON files in the engine's lang folder - including this release's improved Kurdish translation.

Under the hood: host occlusion queries, ZArchive (.zar) dumps run straight from the library, PS5 software video decoding, an MSAA step-down fallback, and 40+ shader, renderer and stability fixes for heavy titles.
This is the first beta release. It may also be the last update - thank you all for your support, and wishing you a happy life.
